### How to read the table

| Item | What it means |
|------|---------------|
| **Gross Salary** | Total pre‑tax, pre‑contribution pay you would be offered. |
| **Net Salary** | What you would take home after all taxes and mandatory contributions. |
| **Tax + Contrib.** | Rough percentage of your gross that goes to taxes and social‑security contributions. |
